facts.claim: Ambassador Aegean Luxury Hotel & Suites (Akrotiri; not Grand Ambassador) home page: 'Perched on the edge of the cliff, overlooking the imposing caldera and the emblematic volcano of Santorini, Ambassador Aegean Luxury Hotel & Suites welcomes you to Akrotiri.'

Ambassador Aegean home page has a 'WEDDING & HONEYMOON' section reading 'Organize a Fairytale Wedding & Magical Honeymoon', and its footer menu lists 'WEDDINGS & HONEYMOONS'. The linked wedding page (/wedding-honeymoons-santorini-hotel/) returned a 404 on 2026-11-12, so no ceremony options, capacity or wedding services are published in a readable page.

Ambassador Aegean home page: 'Our luxury hotel in Santorini offers 40 suites, villas & rooms with private pools' (meta description; body: '40 private pools, one waiting for you'). Signature details named: a private helipad and golf cars for moving around the property. It describes Akrotiri as 'one of Santorini's least exploited areas', a few minutes from the ancient settlement.

Vedema, a Luxury Collection Resort (Megalochori) weddings page: 'Host your wedding in one of our spectacular venues and exchange your vows within a scenery of a traditional Cycladic village.' Ceremonies 'at the resort, on the beach, or elsewhere'; receptions at the Pool Restaurant or, for more privacy, the Canava Wine Bar; a private beach bonfire and barbecue are options.

Vedema home page describes a 400-year-old winery turned Cycladic village retreat in medieval Megalochori, 'surrounded by emerald vineyards'. The only caldera wording is for one villa: 'Hidden away in the Megalochori Caldera, Nafsika Estate combines absolute privacy, spectacular views...' (350 sq.m., private helipad). No caldera VIEW is stated in words for the resort or its wedding spaces, so Vedema does not meet part 2 of the inclusion rule.

Vedema's official Marriott events page says the 400-year-old Wine Cellar can hold up to 120 guests for a banquet and 150 for a reception, and that Vedema provides wedding services (Celebration Consultant). Used only as context; Vedema is not qualified (no caldera view wording).

Katikies Garden (Fira) home page: a five-star hotel with 40 suites in a converted monastery in the heart of Fira. Its caldera wording is about the town, not the hotel: 'Fira is situated on the island's famed Caldera... it promises stunning views and splendid sunsets.' Its FAQ says 'Some of our suites offer sea views, whereas 180° views are offered from the infinity pool'. No caldera view is stated for the property in words, so it does not meet part 2 of the inclusion rule on this read.

Aria Suites (Fira): its home page meta description says 'Explore luxurious suites and villas, spectacular caldera views, private jacuzzis'; its schema says 'an elite boutique hotel in Fira with a view of the volcano and the historic Acrotiri' and gives a 4-star rating. Its Facilities & Services page lists 'Wedding planning' among services. No wedding spaces, ceremony options or capacity are published.

Gavalas Winery (Megalochori) home page: family boutique winery, one of the oldest on Santorini, five generations. The home page mentions neither weddings nor a caldera view, so it does not meet the inclusion rule on this read.

insider_details.detail: Ambassador Aegean sits on the Akrotiri cliffs in the quieter south-west of the island, so guests who want Fira or Oia evenings will need to plan the drive.
